heading.default: Trusted by operations of every scale

default.quote: Expanding our relationship with CropX is a critical next step in our ongoing mission to ensure sustainable cocoa systems. CropX gives us more visibility into growers' sustainability practices.

default.quote: We used to irrigate on gut feel. Now we irrigate on data — and we've cut our water bill by 28% in the first season alone.
The platform gave our agronomists visibility across all 14 properties simultaneously. That kind of oversight simply wasn't possible before.
Setup was faster than any other system we've evaluated, and the recommendations actually match what our soil is doing in the field.
We manage water allocation across 300 farms and CropX is the only platform that gives us real-time insight at that scale.
default.authorTitle: Water Manager, Murray Basin Irrigation District
